messages:
lucy: Quick summary from a short run: nebula-lite-7b int6 on GTN longform + action-extract slices. Need a micro decision for hybrid routing.

devin: top-line numbers?

bench-bot: micro-metrics:
- quant: int6 vs int8
- cost/1k tokens: $0.0033 (int6) vs $0.0057 (int8)
- throughput: +1.7x int6
- regressed evals on action-extract slice: 2.6% (n=1150)
- common failure: truncated lists (2/3 of regressions)

ryan: what % of traffic is similar to that slice?

lucy: ~16% of GTN requests; high conversion.

devin: econ back-of-envelope (100M tokens/day): all-int8 = $570/day, all-int6 = $330/day, hybrid (84% int6) ~ $390/day => saves ~$180/day vs all-int8.

lucy: proposal: canary 5% GTN -> int6 with synchronous shadow to int8; automated list-length check + 150 human spot checks over 48h. Block if critical list-truncation >1.5% or overall regression >2%.

ryan: ops-add: routing flag `nebula_lite_int6_gtn` + fallback to `nebula_lite_int8` on >3% error spike; add `kvcache_hit_ratio` and prompt fingerprint to telemetry. ETA 1d.

oncall: I'll monitor first 24h. Add @oncall mention in thread if block triggers.

devin: agreed. Keep hybrid if diffs stay <= thresholds and human checks pass; otherwise rollback.

lucy: action items recorded. bench-bot will post the 2k diff snapshot later today. Thanks all.
